profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Developer | Java, K8s, React, Angular | F1-OPT
profile.summary:
Senior Java Developer with over a decade of experience building scalable, high-performance applications. I specialize in designing and maintaining RESTful APIs, migrating legacy Spring/Hibernate monoliths to modern architectures, and solving complex performance challenges.

I enjoy owning projects end-to-end—from discussions and design through development, testing, and deployment. Along the way, I’ve customized front-ends with Angular and React, maintained critical core platforms, and helped teams deliver reliable software that drives business value. I also contribute to open-source projects such as DHIS2, a health information platform used by governments worldwide.

Passionate about clean code, performance optimization, and continuous learning, I thrive in collaborative environments where I can contribute to both technical excellence and team growth.


✅ Languages: Java, SQL, JavaScript
✅ Frameworks & Libraries: Spring (Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud), Hibernate, JPA JUnit, React.js, Flyway
✅ Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
✅ Tools & Platforms: Git, Maven, Docker, CI/CD, Jenkins, Gatling, Grafana, JasperReports
✅ Cloud: AWS

positions.title: Master Student
positions.description: Strengthened technical expertise through advanced coursework in Algorithms, Software Architecture, Advanced Software Development, and Big Data Technologies.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.locationName: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam · Remote
positions.description:
- Developed and optimized REST APIs for DHIS2, an open-source health management platform used in over 100 countries.
- Led migration from Spring and Hibernate 5 to 6, refactoring the object model and preparing for a Java 21 upgrade.
- Improved unstructured data performance by 15% through Hibernate–PostgreSQL JsonB integration; optimized SQL & NoSQL data models for analytics and reporting.
- Integrated Gatling testing framework into the CI/CD pipeline, enabling early detection of performance issues
- Leveraged YourKit, Glowroot, and Grafana to monitor and troubleshoot system issues, including long-running queries and memory leaks.
- Designed and implemented an Audit Service using RabbitMQ for asynchronous event processing and compliance tracking.
- Managed API security with Spring Security, OAuth2, and JWT to ensure compliance and enforce access control.
- Wrote unit and integration tests using JUnit, MockMVC, and SpringBootTest within a Docker environment to maintain high test coverage.
- Collaborated with DevOps teams to author and optimize Dockerfiles and Kubernetes manifests, facilitating seamless application deployment and scaling.
- Worked in Agile/Scrum teams, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performance applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Framework · PostgreSQL · Hibernate · JPA · Java · Spring Security · Spring MVC · Flyway · JUnit · Mockito · Perforamnce · Grafana · Prometheus · Micrometer · RabbitMQ · Spring Boot

company.name: HISP Centre at University of Oslo

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.locationName: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam · On-site
positions.description:
- Managed a team of five developers, providing production support for a high-traffic U.S. e-commerce platform.
- Spearheaded the diagnosis and resolution of critical full-stack issues across the Spring backend, AngularJs and React frontend app.
- Leveraged AppDynamics, AWS CloudWatch, and CloudTrail to monitor and trace system activity, rapidly diagnosing and resolving a critical production issue in a distributed environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Framework · MySQL · Solr · Team Leadership · Java · AngularJS · CSS · Elasticsearch · Redis · HTML · JavaScript · AppDynamics · JMX · Troubleshooting · RCA

positions.title: Application Consultant
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained key modules for a patient-centric, web-based J2EE enterprise integrated pharmacy system in JBoss environment  used by 2 hospitals.
- Developed and ran complex SQL migrations for 500M+ HL7 patient records in Oracle, reducing storage by 30% and speeding data retrieval.
- Developed a critical billing module handling $5M+ in pharmacy revenue annually with high accuracy.
- Developed unit tests following BDD principles to enhance overall test coverage and application reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Oracle Database · Spring Framework · Hibernate · JBoss EAP · J2EE · SQL · JBoss Application Server · Enterprise JavaBeans (EJB) · JSP · Struts

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam · Remote
positions.description:
- Designed and developed a comprehensive Health Information System built on the OpenMRS open-source platform (www.openmrs.org), leveraging Spring MVC for backend development and jQuery for interactive frontend features.
- Engineered and implemented key modules, including Patient Registration, Billing, Laboratory, Inpatient Department, Outpatient Department, and Accounting, tailored to meet healthcare workflow requirements.
- Ensured system reliability, scalability, and data accuracy in alignment with healthcare IT best practices and standards.
- Worked in an Agile development environment, contributing to sprint planning, technical documentation, and code reviews to support continuous improvement and collaboration.
positions.insights: Skills: Maven · Tomcat · Spring Framework · jQuery · MySQL · Jenkins · Struts
